panels.title: Requests waiting for the rate limiter

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, queue AS metric, succeeded AS value
FROM job_stats_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Jobs retried and failed per day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, sum(retried) AS retried, sum(failed) AS failed
FROM job_stats_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, service || ' ' || endpoint AS metric, sum(count) AS value
FROM api_request_stats_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: External API mean response time per day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, service AS metric,
  sum(total_duration_ms)::float8 / nullif(sum(count), 0) / 1000 AS value
FROM api_request_stats_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
